source_claim: The official World Witches news article names Karibuchi Hikari, Kanno Naoe, Nikka Edvardine Katajainen, and Nishizawa Yoshiko as performers/characters in World Witches Himeuta Collection releases; it also explicitly identifies Nishizawa as a Fuso witch appearing in World Witches UNITED FRONT.
notes: Only campaign members explicitly named as fictional witch characters in the official article are included. Voice actors and other named characters not in the current campaign are omitted.
